subject: DPA execution: signatory chain, witness needs, and CC routing
messages:
From: Emma Grant <emma.grant@globetech.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.example.com>
Cc: privacy@globetech.com
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: GlobeTech DPA — execution logistics and witness question

Hi Sofia,

Hope you’re well. We reviewed the updated DPA (attached, redline_v3) and GlobeTech Legal has a couple of execution logistics questions before we proceed to signing:  

1) Our procurement team requires a witnessed signature (notarized or witnessed by an authorized witness) for any contract over $250k — can Redwood accommodate a witnessed signature, or do you require countersignature only via e-sign (DocuSign/AdobeSign)?
2) We need visibility into the full signatory chain (who signs, who countersigns, and timestamped audit logs). Please confirm the envelope provider that Redwood will use and whether you can provide the DocuSign/AdobeSign envelope ID and audit trail once complete.
3) Also attached is GlobeTech’s exec authority matrix — please confirm whether the listed person for our CISO (Mariana Li) will be acceptable to you as the signatory for security addenda.

We'd like to get this wrapped up this week if possible.

Thanks,
Emma Grant
Senior Contracts Manager
GlobeTech Inc.
Attachments: GlobeTech_DPA_redline_v3.pdf, Exec_Authority_Matrix_Globetech.pdf
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.example.com>
To: Emma Grant <emma.grant@globetech.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.example.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GlobeTech DPA — execution logistics and witness question

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear notes and the attachments. Quick answers up front, then a proposed execution plan:  

- Witnessed signatures: Redwood’s standard is e-signature (DocuSign). For customers who require witnessing/notarization, we support two options: 1) we proceed with DocuSign and provide the complete audit trail and a notarized/witnessed copy coordinated by the customer after e-sign (GlobeTech supplies the witness), or 2) Redwood can accommodate a wet/witness signature step post-e-sign for this agreement — this requires a countersigned scanned PDF returned to our legal team and will add 2–4 business days. If GlobeTech prefers option 1 we can still meet your timeline.

- Envelope provider and audit logs: We use DocuSign for enterprise deals and will provide the envelope ID and full audit trail (timestamps, IPs) once the envelope completes. DocuSign also provides the signed certificate which meets most audit requirements.

- Signatory chain: we will route to the designated Redwood signatory (VP Legal) for countersignature. To be safe, can you confirm the exact name and title for Mariana Li on your exec matrix (we want the printed name to match the signature block)?

Proposed execution plan (if GlobeTech agrees):
1) Redwood prepares DocuSign envelope containing the final DPA PDF (redline accepted) and Security Addendum.
2) Signing order: GlobeTech signatory (Mariana Li) -> GlobeTech witness step (optional, if you choose witnessed flow) -> Redwood countersign (Aditya Rao, VP Legal).
3) Once envelope is complete, Redwood will: a) upload executed copies to our secure shared drive link, b) send you the DocuSign envelope ID and audit certificate, c) mark the deal as ‘signed’ in our procurement tracker.

If that works, I’ll draft the envelope and loop in Aditya for countersign authority.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Manager, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.example.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.example.com>, Emma Grant <emma.grant@globetech.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.example.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GlobeTech DPA — execution logistics and witness question

Looping in Aditya for countersign. Couple of internal notes for Redwood:  
- If GlobeTech chooses the witnessed workflow (wet witness after e-sign), please confirm the preferred scanned format (PDF/A preferred) and whether GlobeTech requires an original wet-signed PDF in addition to the DocuSign certificate.
- For record-keeping, Legal prefers we attach the exec auth matrix to the DocuSign envelope as a referenced document so the audit trail shows the authority at time of signing. Emma — would you be able to confirm permission to include your Exec_Authority_Matrix_Globetech.pdf in the envelope?

Thanks — I can prepare both envelope variants (pure e-sign and e-sign + witness instruction on completion).

—Lauren
Senior Counsel, Sales Agreements
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.example.com>
To: Emma Grant <emma.grant@globetech.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.example.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.example.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GlobeTech DPA — execution logistics and witness question

Emma / Team — confirmed: Redwood can countersign via DocuSign (enterprise account). A couple of clarifications from Redwood Legal:  
1) Signatory authority: We accept Mariana Li as signatory per the matrix provided, assuming the printed name and title match. If GlobeTech wants the CISO's authorization to be witnessed/notarized, we'll follow the post-e-sign wet-witness workflow.
2) Witnessing: If GlobeTech requires notarization (rather than a witness signature), GlobeTech will need to complete the notarization locally and provide us the notarized scanned copy. Redwood will retain the DocuSign certificate as our primary audit artifact; the notarized PDF will be stored alongside it.
3) Countersignature name and delegation: I (Aditya Rao) will countersign. If for any reason I'm unavailable, our delegated signatory is Marcus Lin (Director, Legal Ops).
4) Security: we will add an internal step in DocuSign to capture the Exec Authority PDF as a referenced doc (per Lauren’s suggestion) and to include an additional signer role 'Witness (optional)' that GlobeTech can use if desired.

Please confirm: a) GlobeTech consents to inclusion of the exec auth matrix in the envelope, and b) whether you want the optional witness role enabled. Once confirmed, Sofia/ Lauren can prepare the envelope and I will countersign.

Aditya Rao
VP, Legal & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Emma Grant <emma.grant@globetech.com>

- Please enable the optional 'Witness' signer role so our local notary can be recorded if we use it.

Emma
